title: Cybersecurity foundations
summary: Build the common security, networking and operating-system knowledge that makes later specialisation easier.
skills: Identity, access control and security principles
Clear technical notes and safe lab practice
portfolioEvidence: Publish a network diagram and a short hardening checklist.
Write a repeatable lab report with commands, expected results and limitations.
Explain one security alert from evidence to conclusion without exposing private data.

title: SOC / Blue Team Analyst
summary: Prioritise security monitoring, alert triage, query skills, incident handling and reproducible detection evidence.
skills: Detection validation, false-positive analysis and clear reporting
portfolioEvidence: Build a small detection rule with benign and suspicious test events.
Publish a sanitised incident timeline and triage note.
Document detection logic, expected events, false positives and repeatable test results.

title: Penetration Testing / Security Assessment
summary: Develop networking and web-security fundamentals before progressing to structured, authorised assessments and reporting.
skills: Web application security testing in designated labs
portfolioEvidence: Write a lab-only finding with scope, impact, safe reproduction and fix guidance.
Create a web-security learning log that cites authorised training labs.
Show a remediation verification report rather than only tool output.

title: Cloud Security Engineer
summary: Learn cloud identity, logging, data protection and configuration review before committing to an advanced vendor-specific exam.
skills: Secure configuration, governance and cost awareness
portfolioEvidence: Create a cloud threat model and identity-policy review using sample configuration.
Analyse synthetic cloud audit events and document detection opportunities.
Publish a remediation checklist; avoid incurring cloud charges without a budget and supervision.

title: Digital Forensics & Incident Response
summary: Prioritise evidence handling, logs, timeline reconstruction and repeatable defensive investigation before advanced specialist credentials.
skills: Timeline construction and incident containment concepts
portfolioEvidence: Investigate a provided or synthetic log set and produce a timestamped timeline.
Document evidence sources, handling steps, assumptions and gaps.
Separate observed facts from hypotheses and give a defensible next-step recommendation.

title: GRC / IT Audit / Risk
summary: Focus on security controls, risk analysis, evidence quality, audit communication and experience-dependent professional credentials.
portfolioEvidence: Create a fictional risk register with likelihood, impact and treatments.
Map a small set of security controls to evidence items and known gaps.
Write an audit finding with condition, criteria, impact and corrective action.

title: Application Security / DevSecOps
summary: Combine secure development basics with threat modelling, code review, testing and evidence of fixes.
skills: HTTP, sessions, access control and common web risks
Code review, test results and remediation
Security checks integrated into development workflows
portfolioEvidence: Document a threat model for a small demo app.
Fix a deliberately vulnerable training example and record a regression test.
Create a simple CI security-check note with its limits and follow-up steps.

title: Threat Intelligence / Malware Analysis
summary: Start with trustworthy intelligence sources, observable evidence and defensive detections before specialist threat-research credentials.
skills: Indicator context, source quality and confidence
Safe, defensive reporting and reproducible evidence
portfolioEvidence: Write a threat brief based on reputable public reports and cite every claim.
Map observed defensive indicators to ATT&CK techniques with uncertainty stated.
Create a defensive detection or triage note using synthetic/public training data only.

title: Security Engineering / Architecture
summary: Progress from broad security fundamentals to operational design, identity, hardening, governance and architecture-level decisions.
skills: Monitoring, response and secure cloud design
Architecture trade-offs, governance and technical communication
portfolioEvidence: Publish a threat model and architecture decision record for a lab system.
Build a hardening baseline with testable controls and exception notes.
Demonstrate one repeatable security check and document what it cannot detect.
